title: Record
intro: A faithful mirror of the in-game acquisition log — read straight from the game's complete in-memory record timeline and synced in real time. Each row's mode badge is fitted against the three event buckets (chest drops / box opens / stage clears); unfitted lines are grouped as hero / synthesis by their text. Informational only.
